name: What are common features of a multifunctional living space?

mainEntity.name: What are common features of a multifunctional living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common features include modular furniture, built-in storage, and flexible layouts. Modular furniture can be reconfigured or moved easily to suit different needs, such as sectional sofas that can become individual chairs. Built-in storage, like under-stair drawers or wall-integrated shelving, keeps items out of sight and reduces clutter. Flexible layouts often involve open-concept designs or movable partitions that allow occupants to redefine areas as needed. Other features might include pull-out tables, folding desks, and multi-purpose seating that also offers storage, all designed to enhance efficiency and adaptability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common features include modular furniture, built-in storage, and flexible layouts that allow spaces to be easily reconfigured for different activities.
